prompt: Vertical 9:16 tight close shot inside a speeding UK ambulance at night, camera low beside a portable heart monitor bolted to a white cupboard. In the soft foreground the monitor screen glows green with a fast, jagged, chaotic heart trace and blurred unreadable numbers. Behind it, in sharp focus, a female paramedic in a plain dark-green uniform and surgical mask stares at the screen, eyes wide, sweat on her brow, mid-shout, one blue-gloved hand gripping a grab rail. Past her shoulder a male paramedic pumps a bag-valve mask over an older man's face. Cold fluorescent top light, green monitor glow on her skin, a slash of blue strobe across the teal seat. 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain, handheld. Thanks.
